idea-plugin.name: Fintech AI Code Reviewer
idea-plugin.description:
AI code review for Java / Spring Boot fintech backends, inside the IDE.

Reads your local uncommitted changes, staged changes, recent commits or the whole branch diff against a base branch, sends them to an LLM of your choice (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) and streams a structured review back into a dedicated tool window on the right.

  • Enforces fintech domain rules: data integrity, idempotency, auditability, ACID.
  • Scans for OWASP Top 10 issues: injection, XSS, IDOR, broken access control.
  • Applies the team's Top 10 Java / Spring Boot rules (DI, thin controllers, transactions, N+1, validation, logging, config, null safety, immutability).
  • Findings are split into 🔴 Must Do and 🟡 Should Do, each with deep reasoning and a one-click Copy code button on the suggested fix.

Works in IntelliJ IDEA and WebStorm (and any other JetBrains IDE with Git support).
idea-plugin.change-notes: 1.0.0 - initial release: Git-aware review sources, four LLM providers with streaming, structured Must Do / Should Do output, credential-store token storage.
